name: Saqib Mustafa Abbasi
objective: Obtain a challenging position providing opportunities to hone my professional skills and effectively contribute to organizational progress and simultaneously provide opportunities for career development and personal growth.
details: IT professional with 20+ years of experience spanning software engineering, business analysis, technical consulting, enterprise application support, software integration, data migration, information security, and business continuity. Currently serving as Manager at Feroze1888 Mills Limited, with hands-on experience across Oracle EBS R12 HRMS, Oracle/PLSQL, .NET, SQL Server, web portals, core banking systems, and enterprise integrations. Experienced in translating business requirements into practical technology solutions, coordinating business and vendor teams, mentoring technical staff, and improving operational processes.
